priorityList: Apply poisons and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready and you are at low Combo Points.
Cast Shadow Dance if not in Stealth, provided you have low Combo Points and either Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Vanish if not in Stealth and at 1 or fewer Combo Points to generate resources and enable Stealth abilities.
Cast Shadowstrike when Darkest Night is active and Shadow Techniques has 5 or more stacks to trigger Unseen Blade.
Spend Combo Points on finishers when at max capacity if Darkest Night is active, or at max minus 1 if it is not.
Cast Secret Technique as your top priority finisher during Shadow Dance, or if it will be available again before the next Shadow Dance.
Cast Eviscerate as a priority finisher whenever the Darkest Night buff is active.
Cast Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or if Shadow Dance is active.
Cast Eviscerate as a general finisher if other high-priority finishers are unavailable.
Cast Shadowstrike as your primary builder while Stealthed or during Shadow Dance.
Use Goremaw's Bite as a builder if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Cast Gloomblade (or Backstab) as your primary builder when not in Stealth or Shadow Dance.
Sync on-use trinkets and offensive racials with your Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance windows.
